# Cursor context

Read [AGENT_CONTEXT.md](AGENT_CONTEXT.md) first — it holds what is true for
every tool — and [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the authority. This file carries
only what is specific to Cursor in this repository.

Generated from `agentic/manifest.yaml`; an edit here survives until the next
render and no longer.

## Your surface

`.cursor/` is rendered in **pointer** mode: each file names its canonical body under `agentic/` and restates none of it, so what you read there is an address and never the policy itself. Act on the canonical body, not on the pointer.

| Kind | Where | Files |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rules | `.cursor/rules/*.mdc` | 23 |
| skills | `.cursor/skills/*.mdc` | 29 |
| workflows | `.cursor/commands/*.mdc` | 22 |

## What that means when you work here

- `.cursor/rules/*.mdc` are rendered by the same generator as every other surface, so they carry **no `globs:` / `alwaysApply:` front-matter**. Cursor therefore attaches none of them automatically — a rule binds because `AGENTS.md` says it does, not because the editor injected it. Read the ones covering your files yourself.
- A file under `.cursor/commands/` backs the `/<name>` command; a file under `.cursor/skills/` names a procedure. Both are pointers — the body they name under `agentic/` is the thing to read.
- Do not add front-matter to a `.mdc` file to make it auto-attach: it is generated output and the next `sync_agentic_adapters.py` run deletes the edit. Auto-attachment is a renderer change, in `scripts/sync_agentic_adapters.py`.

## MCP

- Config path for this surface: `~/.cursor/mcp.json` — never committed.
- Committed example: none — there is nothing tool-specific to template.
- Servers this surface may not install without an explicit human decision: `terraform`.
- Nothing is installed automatically. `agentic/mcp_registry.yaml` declares each server's ceiling risk mode, and adding one is a supply-chain decision made on the repository's behalf.

## The mode contract

Every operation carries AUTO, CONSULT or STOP — the three are defined in
[CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md#auto-consult-stop) and mapped operation by
operation in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md#agent-behavior-protocol). The mode is a
property of the operation, not of the tool running it and not of your
confidence in it: the same procedure carries the same mode here as on every
other surface, and a surface that appears to weaken one has drifted.

## Editing

Never edit a file under `.cursor/`, and never edit this file. Edit the
canonical body under `agentic/`, then:

```bash
python scripts/sync_agentic_adapters.py
python scripts/validate_agentic_surface.py --strict
```
